description: This script is a utility written in Perl for flashing firmware onto a D-Link DSL-G6x4T device. It performs network discovery of the device via UDP broadcast, establishes FTP connection, uploads firmware to specific memory partitions, and handles reboots. It includes custom FTP command wrappers and network communication code specific to the device upgrade process.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP tailored for the ADAM2 device, implementing custom commands for environment variable retrieval, reboot, and using upper-case commands required by the device's FTP server.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command to the FTP server, using uppercase as required by the device.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable values from the FTP server with a custom command GETENV.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables from the device.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends the REBOOT command to the FTP server to reboot the device.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device via FTP.
